name: Yonkoma Vol. 1
source:
My roommate is a writer...
Four people are sharing the same apartment. A creepypasta writer, a photography student, a penniless psychic and Satan.

[From [url=https://wandeer.itch.io/yonkoma-vol-1]itch.io[/url]]

我的室友是一位作家…

[来自[url=https://wandeer.itch.io/yonkoma-vol-1]itch.io[/url]]
